lcc_original: 亞伯也帶了他羊羣中那些頭一胎生的、和羊的脂肪來獻上。永恆主看中了亞伯和他的供物；
notes: H0935 (הֵבִיא, bring/come) placed at end of the split verbal construction '帶了...來獻上', following UNV's pattern of tagging at the end of the verbal phrase; '帶了' is part of LCC's periphrastic rendering and has no separate Hebrew lexeme.
H01931 (הוּא, he) attaches to '他' in '帶了他'; the preceding '帶了' is part of the verbal idea, not a discrete Hebrew word.
Both {<WAH0413>} markers kept implicit: LCC also uses no explicit preposition before 亞伯 or 供物, mirroring UNV.
永恆主 is LCC's rendering of יְהוָה (H03068), replacing UNV's 耶和華; tagged identically.
